data_with_no_home: Stapled structure: Stoneweg European REIT (constituted 28 Apr 2017, listed 30 Nov 2017) + Stoneweg European BT (constituted 21 May 2025); stapled security commenced trading 16 Jun 2025. Three-column statements (REIT Group / BT Group / SERT=Stapled Group). SERT (Stapled Group) used as canonical throughout.

Investment in financial asset (AiOnX data-centre fund) held via the Business Trust at fair value €70,536k (€50m cost + €20,536k FV uplift); change in FV €20,536k flows into SERT total return. Equity/fair-value accounted, NOT a row in the consolidated Portfolio Statement. SERT ~6.6% stake; Dublin site held 39.8%.

Portfolio by country (p44): NL 28%, France 22%, Italy 17%, Germany 10%, Poland 7%, Denmark 7%, Czech 4%, Slovakia 3%, UK 2%, Finland 2%. By asset class: Logistics/light industrial 54.1%, Data centre 5.2%, Office 38.7%, Others 2.0%.
Weighted average all-in interest rate 3.86% p.a. at year end (3.90% average for FY2025). Weighted avg debt maturity 5.6 years; no debt maturities until 2030. Debt 94% fixed/hedged.
WALE 4.9 years (top-10 tenant WALE 7.1 yrs; WALB 4.0 yrs). 780 tenant-customers, ~1,000 leases, no single tenant >4% of rent; top-10 = 21.4% of headline rent.
Property & portfolio management fee €15,718k (0.67% of deposited property), shown WITHIN property operating expense in the Statement of Total Return (not a separate trust-expense line).
Perpetual securities holders' funds €64,204k (SGD-denominated perpetuals); distribution €2,325k.
Market capitalisation €907.7m; gross borrowings €1,003.0m; total facilities €1,217.4m (utilised €1,003.0m).
parsing_traps: Statement of Portfolio (p174-185) is a FACING-PAGE POSITIONAL SPLIT: property name/location/acquisition-date on left pages (174,176,178,180,182,184) and land-tenure/remaining-term/carrying-amount on right pages (175,177,179,181,183,185), with NO label column on the value table — rows aligned by position. Adapter cannot positional-join, so properties were built with a positional-zip script, VERIFIED by reconciling each country x asset-class subtotal to the segment note (p188-190) exactly and the grand total to €2,152,528k.

REIT column and SERT (Stapled Group) column are identical for the Portfolio Statement and Statement of Total Return because all investment properties sit in the REIT Group; the BT Group holds only the AiOnX financial asset. SERT column used as canonical.
DPS for FY2025 = 13.390 Euro cents (declared); distributions PAID during the year = 13.609 cents (2H2024 7.056 + 1H2025 6.553). Distribution statement on SERT basis only.
Italy 'Others' includes Starhotels Grand Milan (480-room hotel) and a leisure/cinema complex - classified by the trust under 'Others', mapped to category Specialized.
